paragraphs.text: The real work begins after the contract is signed: our team must transfer the customer records, reconcile opening balances, and get the customer's finance lead to approve them. Until that approval, invoices continue through the old system.
The honest work starts. The conference has closed, and the printed programs are already stacked beside the coat rack; someone has left a fountain pen across the registration book.
The hard work starts after the applause fades. The festival brochure includes a foldout map of the performance spaces, with the outdoor stage shaded green and the puppet theater marked by a star.
The actual work begins when we learn to sit with doubt. During the retreat, participants ate at long pine tables and slept in rooms that had once housed the railway staff.

The actual work begins with scraping the loose paint, filling the window-frame cracks, and sanding the repairs before priming. Each operation appears as a separate line on the decorator's inspection sheet.
The real work begins with producing a signed evacuation map for each floor before the building inspection. The final PDF must show the accessible exits and the assembly point across the service lane.
The hard work starts at 06:00 in the quarry, when the loading crew takes over from the night watch. Their shift ends at 14:00, before the blasting area closes for inspection.

The debate had reached its closing exchange. That was where the honest work began. In the published account, a sketch of the auditorium occupies the facing page, showing the balcony above the central aisle.
For a partnership, this is where the deeper work begins. The handbook prints that passage beside a photograph of the founders at a picnic, with their bicycles leaning against a stone bridge.
